pages.text: An Agegleam is an Arcane Gem formed from a green-spectrum piece of $(l:items/shaped_quartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() in an asscher cut.$(br2)When activated, the amount of time until nearby animals grow up will be significantly reduced, at the cost of charge for each animal affected.
To recharge a dun Agegleam, simply hold onto it. It regains one point of charge every three minutes.
